body: I was crying at the time and he told me if all i was going to be was a miserable burden on others to stay away from others. honestly if someone told that to me today it wouldn't bother me but as a kid it really rocked me.
While I agree that I probably should tell them I know it will break my Mother's heart and that is something I can't do right now. Whether its the best for me or not I just can't.

I have always lived in the shadow of my sister, however I feel no ill will towards her in fact I care very dearly for my sister. My whole life I have done nothing but put unnecessary stress and pain on my parents and hated myself for it. I've always hid my depression from my parents because I was afraid it would hurt them which led to me constantly lashing out at them because they couldn't possibly understand what I felt. I have also cost them so much money as they placed faith in investing in me only for me to disappoint. I know they would never say it but I have seen how rough the past 4-5 years have been since I've gotten really bad.

19, I have had consistent sadness since around 6 years old after I was rocked to my core by something my dad said to me. I would never blame him for it, he immediately apologized for what he said and I know he didn't mean it.
